name: MenteeBot
summary: An AI-first humanoid from Israel's Mentee Robotics, co-founded by Mobileye's Amnon Shashua. The company's pitch is an end-to-end software stack — simulation-trained locomotion, natural-language task planning and learned manipulation — running on relatively conventional hardware, for both warehouse and household use.
notable: Founded by senior figures from Mobileye and academic deep learning
End-to-end, simulation-to-real AI stack as the core differentiator
